capabilities: Insert emojis from a searchable picker via command, ribbon or right-click
Type :shortcode suggestions and convert complete shortcodes like :tada:
Search emojis by name, keyword, shortcode or a pasted emoji
Set skin tone and rank frequently used emojis first
Suppress suggestions in code, math, links, URLs and frontmatter keys
extras: Works entirely offline and never uses the network; emoji data comes from emojibase-data (Unicode CLDR annotations).
intentEvidence: Emoji Toolbar is no longer updated. Emoji Search covers the same picker
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert emojis, and the existing Emoji Toolbar plugin is no longer updated.

relations.evidence: Emoji Toolbar is no longer updated. Emoji Search covers the same picker
Emoji names, keywords and shortcodes come from emojibase-data (MIT)

summary: Emoji insertion plugin that offers a searchable, offline emoji picker and converts :shortcode typing into emojis as you write.
